name: Tunisia Spring Open 2017

venue.name: Hotel  Orient Palace
venue.details: In the conference room of the hotel

information: Tunisia Open 2017 is open for participants from all countries, everyone is welcome. Competition fee is 10DT per participant who is registered in the mathematical campus, 20DT for other competitors Medals and Gifts will be awarded to the winners in each category. It should be known that only competitors who do check-in into the hotel can benefit from the lunch.
